title: Anubian
summary: Anubian, the Scarab Lord, is a powerful and unusual Titan, Anubian is formed by calling together the Black Scarabese and Gold Scarabese Titans. A Seeker must have enough power and control to command all five Titans to form Anubian.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Black and Gold Scarabese were brought out of storage by Rassimov after losing Behemoth. Anubian then was used Rassimov at the Temple of Poseidon to fight against the Huntik Foundation. As a result of his strength and abilities, Anubian soundly defeated the Foundation's Titans, Caliban, Lindorm, Sabriel, and Kilthane, forcing a retreat to Atlantis. [The Unseen Guide]

Anubian was used again in the fight in Atlantis where Rassimov and Lok Lambert fought one on one. Although he defeated Lok's Lindorm, he was ultimately taken down by the powerful Baselaird and returned to his Amulet upon being sliced by the magical barrier protecting the room to the Amulet of Will. [Coming of Age]

His Amulet was seen being contained and locked away after Dante Vale used Sorrowbond to unbond him and Rassimov's other Titans from their Seeker. Dante instructed the Huntik Foundation agents to keep the Gold Scarabese separate to prevent any chance of Anubian being formed again. [Rassimov's Secret]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S1E20 Anubian Sabriel.png|thumb|Anubian in the midst of splitting one of its eyes to avoid [[Sabriel]]'s sword slice]]
Anubian possesses large eyes on its knees and hands. It can also hover in air, moving without having to touch the ground; Anubian can use this and his strength to smash into enemies with its arms, toss them around {{source|The Unseen Guide}}, and rip apart [[Titans]] such as [[Lindorm]] in half {{Source|Coming of Age}}. It also has the ability to split up its body in sand to avoid the attack beforehand, causing it to become sand and then reform into a solid structure again {{source|The Unseen Guide}}; or even split up into [[Scarabese]] to avoid defeat {{source|TCG:LGS-016|LGS-016}}. It also has the ability to manipulate desert sand both offensively and defensively {{sourceneeded}}. Furthermore, with his Obsidian Sword ability, it can extend a large blade from the eyes on its arms to be used for direct combat{{source|The Unseen Guide}}; Anubian can also fire flame blasts from those eyes. {{source|TCG:LGS-080|LGS-080}} Anubian can hold its own even when fighting [[Sabriel]], [[Caliban]], [[Kilthane]] and [[Lindorm]] at the same time. {{source|The Unseen Guide}} However, Caliban by himself has been shown to overpower it in strength. {{source|TCG:LGS-064|LGS-064}}
